Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Distinguish implemented behavior from planned work.

Validation:

- Record the exact commands executed and their actual results.
- Identify platforms, feature profiles, or external integrations that were not tested.
- Explain changes to authority, effect recovery, encoding, resource bounds, or dependencies when applicable.

Review checklist:

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and relevant failure cases.
- [ ] Documentation and implementation status agree with the change.
- [ ] Dependency additions are exact, needed, and supported by primary-source evidence.
- [ ] No secrets, live provider calls, unsupported guarantees, or publication changes were introduced.
